title: Three-tag Praxis with concurrent anchor tables
claims: params.json is a parameter set of Praxis for the reference statement at 100-bit security whose ciphertext is 5308 MiB (5.1835 GiB) and whose time, one encryption plus one expected decryption, is 99985 million field multiplications (14187 and 85798), by the protected model, and every rule of the model as amended holds for it; proof.md proves that each amended entry (I3, Ncmp, I6, I4, n2, dec_msm_g1, dec_msm_g2, dec_pairings, n1, C6, C7, dec_sum_g2, H2, P1, C5, n, H3, D, ell, Bsearch, T_tr, dec_sum_g1, search_spread, msis_bound) is sound, so that the paper's theorems hold for these parameters as rules.md requires.
